data.gender_notes: Wilt is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word wiltan, meaning to will or to want. The name Wilt signifies a person who is willing, resilient, and determined. This name has Germanic origins and is used primarily in the English-speaking world. The name Wilt carries the meaning “Willing, resilient” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wilt usually hope their child will grow to embody willing, resilient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a strong will and unwavering determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Wilt belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Willing, resilient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wilt total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

His name and legacy continue to inspire and intrigue people globally.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Wilt has spiritual significance in that it represents a desire to strive towards one's goals and to be willing to put in the effort required to achieve them. This name also embodies resilience and determination, reminding us to keep pushing forward despite the challenges and adversities we may encounter in life. Ultimately, the name Wilt invites us to tap into our inner strength and willpower to live our best lives and fulfill our divine purpose.
